# Deployment inventory

Every cluster, Talos machine, pointer directory and Flux Kustomization in
this repository, derived from the tree itself by `tools/gen-inventory.sh`. An
app appears here because a pointer file exists for it under
`kubernetes/apps/<location>/`, which is what makes it deployed at all — so
this file cannot disagree with the repository.

One distinction worth reading carefully: the *pointer directory* is where the
Flux Kustomization file lives in this repo. It is usually also the namespace
the objects land in, but not always — a pointer can set `targetNamespace`.
Where the two differ the row shows `→ ns <name>`, and each cluster gets a
table of the exceptions.

Regenerate after adding or removing an app:

```bash
tools/gen-inventory.sh
```

`tools/check-diagram.sh` fails when the committed copy is out of date. For
the reasoning behind any of these components see
[the architecture reference](architecture.md); for the picture, see the
diagram in the [README](../../README.md#architecture).
